title: Anthropic Claude Fable 5.2 is now available on Unity Gateway
body:
Anthropic [Claude Fable 5.2](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis/supported-models#claude-fable-5-2) is now available on Unity Gateway. You can access this model using [Foundation Model APIs](/aws/en/machine-learning/foundation-model-apis).

Customers are responsible for ensuring their compliance with [applicable terms](/aws/en/machine-learning/model-serving/acceptable-use-models).
